entities.name: Rezajaelis Agnaus
entities.description: A vedalken lawmage of the Azorius Senate on Ravnica who learns to integrate diverse perspectives into the law.

entities.name: Azorius Senate
entities.description: The Ravnican guild of lawmages to which Reza belongs.

entities.name: Hendrik
entities.description: A large, friendly man of the Thinktank who helped Reza.

entities.name: Thinktank
entities.description: A chaotic, ungoverned area of inventors on Ravnica, later recognized by law.

entities.name: Old Laws Library
entities.description: Library where Reza searched for Tagan.

entities.name: Ravnica
entities.description: Plane of the Azorius and the Thinktank.

events.summary: Tagan tells Reza that his law rune will be inscribed in the skies above New Prahv.
events.quote: Tagan informed Reza that his latest law rune had been highly praised and would be inscribed in the skies above New Prahv .

events.summary: On a first griffin flight Reza is startled by an electrical attack and falls into the Thinktank, where Hendrik offers help.
events.quote: He landed in a pile of trash in the Thinktank, a chaotic and ungoverned area

events.summary: Reza meets Janin, has a panic attack in the crowd and is mugged.
events.quote: Reza experienced a panic attack in the crowd, and while seeking solitude, he was mugged.

events.summary: Azorius arresters mistake Reza for a suspect; Hendrik and Janin help him escape in a stolen Azorius vehicle.
events.quote: He narrowly escaped, thanks to Hendrik and Janin in a stolen Azorius vehicle.

events.summary: Reza conjures a law rune granting the Thinktank sovereignty so Azorius forces can subdue an electrical elemental.
events.quote: Reza conjured a law rune to grant the Thinktank sovereignty, allowing Azorius forces to intervene.

events.summary: Back in New Prahv Reza drafts a law recognizing the Thinktank Enclave, and Tagan challenges him to become a mentor.
events.quote: His mentor, Tagan, challenged him to become a mentor himself

relations.quote: searching for his sphinx mentor, Tagan
part of the Azorius Senate on the plane of Ravnica
The elemental was subdued, solidifying Reza’s bond with Hendrik and Janin.
